title: L1 comparative review record
description: One comparative L1 review (AES-V2.6 / SUE-564): a subject output compared pairwise against a relevant GOOD reference, never scored as one opaque number. Evidence spans are mandatory. tie and abstain are first-class outcomes. Integrity failures dominate stylistic wins — enforced by scripts/lib/l1-core.mjs, not merely stated. final_authority is always human: this record informs routing, it never grants publication or preference authority — see editorial/HITL-PROTOCOL.md, which stays the stronger authority. schema_version 1.1.0 (AES-V2.17 / SUE-607) adds the optional top-level `language_quality` block: seven absolute (non-comparative) language-quality dimensions, distinct from the comparative `dimensions[]` array above. 1.1.0 requires `language_quality`; 1.0.0 records are unaffected and must not carry it — enforced by scripts/lib/l1-core.mjs.

dimensions.description: At minimum: thesis-worth, synthesis-independence, language-native-prose, formulaic-ai-shaped, audience-fit. Additional dimensions may be added; none of the required five may be omitted.

outcome.description: PASS, TIE, and ABSTAIN carry no rework. The four REWORK outcomes route into AES-V2.5's layer vocabulary via routes_to.

routes_to.description: Must be one of AES-V2.5's layer ids (editorial/feedback-routing.json), or null for PASS/TIE/ABSTAIN. Cross-checked against that table by scripts/lib/l1-core.mjs so the two packages cannot drift apart.

language_quality.description: SUE-607 / AES-V2.17: absolute (non-comparative) verdicts on the seven language-quality dimensions fixed by docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §8. Unlike `dimensions[]` above, these are never judged against a reference — whether spacing is correct, whether terminology is right, whether the voice matches the owner's are questions with an absolute answer, not a comparative one, so they are not crammed into the comparative array. This block deliberately carries no total, score, or overall field: nothing here sums or averages across the seven dimensions, and a consumer that wants one number is asking the wrong question. Required when schema_version is 1.1.0; must be absent when schema_version is 1.0.0 — a 1.0.0 record carrying it is a version defect. Both rules are enforced by scripts/lib/l1-core.mjs, not this schema.

language.description: BCP-47 tag for the language under evaluation, e.g. ko-KR.

pack_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the governing editorial/profiles/language/<tag>.json pack, or null when no pack yet governs this language.

polish_decision_ref.description: AES-V2.18 / SUE-610. Optional: present when this L1 review is reviewing a draft that already went through the conservative polish execution contract (schemas/polish-decision.schema.json) — points at the `decision_id` of the polish decision under review. Absent when no polish decision exists yet for this subject, e.g. a pre-polish review. Not cross-validated by scripts/lib/l1-core.mjs; it is a pointer, not a gate.

dimensions.description: Exactly the seven dimensions named in docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §8, each exactly once. json-schema-lite has no minItems/uniqueItems, so completeness and non-duplication are enforced by scripts/lib/l1-core.mjs.

final_authority.description: Always human. L1 is advisory: it can recommend rework and it can recommend PASS, but it never accepts, publishes, or overrides an owner preference. See editorial/HITL-PROTOCOL.md and the may_not boundary in skills/review-l1/SKILL.md.

mode.description: pairwise is the default. tie and abstain are recorded here when no reference produced a decidable comparison at all, distinct from a per-dimension tie/abstain verdict.

references.description: The GOOD reference(s) compared against. Empty only when mode is abstain.

same_content_type.description: Whether every reference shares the subject's content_type. Compare like with like: Research to Research, News to News.

cross_cutting_dimension.description: Required when same_content_type is false. The only dimension genuinely cross-cutting enough to justify a cross-type reference, e.g. language-native-prose.

ref.description: A reference evaluation id, corpus entry id, or article id used as the comparison GOOD.

lineage_ref.description: Semantically required whenever provenance_class is "generated_output" — enforced by scripts/lib/l1-core.mjs, not this schema, because json-schema-lite has no conditional (if/then) keyword. Identifies the generation lineage so the anti-collapse rule can be evaluated; its absence no longer disables that rule (AES-V2 B5) — every reference_used being generated_output triggers anti-collapse regardless of lineage_ref.

anti_collapse.description: The anti-collapse rule: if every selected GOOD reference is a generated_output from the same lineage, the review must say so rather than silently treating the system's own prior outputs as an independent standard.

language_dimension_finding.description: One absolute verdict on one of SUE-607's seven language-quality dimensions. Not comparative — see language_quality above.

verdict.description: Absolute, not comparative. UNKNOWN is first-class: silence is not acceptance, and owner_voice_fit is UNKNOWN until a human says otherwise (docs/architecture/LANGUAGE-QUALITY-ARCHITECTURE.md §8). NOT_APPLICABLE is for a dimension that genuinely does not apply to this subject.

evidence_span.description: Mandatory for every verdict, exactly like dimension_finding's evidence_span: a verdict with no observable evidence is not a verdict. An honest UNKNOWN or NOT_APPLICABLE verdict still names what could not be observed, or why the dimension does not apply here.

routes_to.description: The feedback-routing layer (editorial/feedback-routing.json) a FAIL routes to. Null or absent for any non-FAIL verdict. Each dimension has exactly one legal layer; cross-checked, including that fixed mapping, by scripts/lib/l1-core.mjs.

verdict.description: better/worse are relative to the reference. tie and abstain are first-class, never forced into a false preference.

evidence_span.description: A quoted sentence, named paragraph, or measured observation from the subject (and the reference, where relevant). Mandatory for every verdict, including tie: a verdict with no observable evidence is not a verdict. A genuine abstain still names what could not be observed.

integrity.description: Integrity failures dominate stylistic wins, always. A better-written piece that is less true loses.

evidence_span.description: Required whenever status is not clear.

evaluator.description: AES-V2 FIX (B7): full runtime lineage, not merely an evaluator kind. §7's model-drift contract requires L1's writer-facing counterpart — the reviewer — to be drift-detectable exactly like a renderer. Field names deliberately match visual-job.schema.json's `renderer`/`runtime` $defs.

agent.description: Present only when type is "agent". provider/model/model_version are required so a silent reviewer-model swap is detectable, never a transparent implementation detail.
